name: @map-harness/spatial-observability
description: Spatial observability and operations library: the versioned `spatial-observability@1` contract — versioned correlation fields (operationRef/runId/goalRevision/traceId) with an ambient propagation scope, the closed outcome vocabulary (succeeded/partial/failed/cancelled/outcome_unknown/degraded) and versioned error codes, low-cardinality metric labels with the closed plane/segment/provider vocabularies, visible sanitization of credentials/user data/geometry/paths, structured logs whose failures and audit facts are never sampled away, per-plane health (process/provider/catalog/run/data/render) with readiness aggregation and transition history, the deterministic fault-injection matrix (flush/artifact-publish/provider/worker/render) with replay recovery, and the bounded sanitized diagnostic export. Telemetry failures are counted (telemetry degraded) and never block the spatial result. A pure library — no host row.
